content_types.talking_head: One person speaking to camera for most of the reel.
content_types.screen_recording: Mostly a phone or computer screen being shown.
content_types.broll_story: A story told over B-roll footage, often with a voiceover.
content_types.list: Numbered points or a countdown ('5 ways to...').
content_types.tutorial: Step-by-step how-to the viewer can follow along with.
content_types.before_after: A clear before and after: a transformation, a result, a redo.
content_types.reaction: Reacting to someone else's post, video, comment or news.
content_types.skit: Acted scene, characters or a comedy bit.
content_types.carousel_video: Still images or slides played as a video.

hook_styles.question: Opens with a question to the viewer.
hook_styles.bold_claim: Opens with a strong statement or promise.
hook_styles.result_first: Shows or says the result before explaining how.
hook_styles.story_open: Drops straight into a story moment ('Last week I...').
hook_styles.mistake_callout: Calls out a mistake the viewer is probably making.
hook_styles.list_promise: Promises a number of things ('3 apps that...').
hook_styles.contrarian: Goes against common advice ('Stop doing X').
hook_styles.curiosity_gap: Hints at something without saying it, so the viewer stays to find out.
hook_styles.direct_address: Names the viewer or their situation ('If you're a coach with...').
hook_styles.visual_only: No spoken hook; the first frame or on-screen text does the work.
